Fast, customizable prefab homes and modular buildings for construction sites, offices, dormitories, residential homes, commercial buildings, and emergency use.

Modular Container Home Solutions

NEW BRAND provides modular container home solutions for projects that require faster delivery, flexible layouts, and reliable factory-built quality. From design to installation, we support custom layouts and project-specific dimensions, enabling clients to adapt container homes to different site conditions, budgets, and timelines.

About NEW BRAND

NEW BRAND is a professional prefab modular container house manufacturer based in [Location], China. [Company history to be supplied], we have been dedicated to designing and manufacturing container houses for a wide range of project requirements.

Our product portfolio includes expandable, detachable, foldable, and flat-pack container houses, as well as container offices, shops, schools, hospitals, and other modular building solutions. We support custom layouts, project-specific dimensions, and OEM/ODM services to help clients find the right fit for their site, budget, and timeline.

Our products are used in projects worldwide, including the USA, Germany, Russia, France, Australia, Thailand, the Philippines, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and South Africa.

NEW BRAND Factory & Quality Control

NEW BRAND has built a manufacturing system focused on stable quality, customization, and efficient production. Our factory team works on product design, structural manufacturing, inspection, and shipment preparation to support project delivery.

We pay attention to material selection, structure stability, and product consistency so our container houses can perform well in a variety of environments and project conditions.

Guide to Container Office Buildings: Types, Uses & How to Choose
Container office buildings provide ready-to-use workspaces in hours or days, making them a practical alternative to traditional construction. Whether used for a construction site, a remote mining camp, a commercial setting, or during a company move, a container office building can meet all the needs.



This guide answers all of that in plain terms. We'll cover what container office buildings are, the different types available, what they typically cost, how long they take to set up, and what to look for when choosing a supplier.

How to Plan a Modular Camp with Container Houses?

What Prefab Construction Are Sandwich Panels Used For?
Sandwich panels are widely used in industrial buildings, warehouses, cold storage facilities, modular housing, temporary site buildings, agricultural facilities, and clean rooms because they combine strong thermal insulation, lightweight structure, and fast installation.

Capsule House vs. Apple Cabin: Which Is Better for Homestay Projects?
If you are planning a homestay, resort, or short-stay hospitality project, the choice often comes down to a capsule house or an apple cabin. In most homestay scenarios, an apple cabin is the more practical option for guest comfort and rental performance; a capsule house is better when the project needs a stronger visual identity or a more futuristic guest experience.

How to Unload and Install a Folding Container House?

Post-War Container House: Modular Solutions for Reconstruction
Post-war container house is a rapidly deployable, prefabricated, modular steel housing solution designed for rapid reconstruction following conflicts or natural disasters, as well as for emergency, temporary, or permanent housing. These homes are converted from durable containers and feature high structural strength, making them an efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective housing reconstruction. They provide safe and comfortable prefab modular emergency housing for conflict-affected regions and displaced populations.

Container Restrooms for Construction Sites: A Cleaner Site Solution
When you're managing a construction project, sanitation is one of the underpowered logistical decisions made during project planning. Choosing the wrong sanitation unit at the start of a project creates problems that compound over time: odor, crowding, poor privacy, maintenance headaches, and OSHA exposure.



That's why more contractors and project managers are turning to container restrooms - a durable, customizable, and easy‑to‑deploy sanitation solution that fits the needs of modern construction sites. NEW BRAND designs and supplies container restroom solutions built for harsh construction environments. Whether you're working on a short‑term foundation job, a long‑term commercial project, or a remote infrastructure site.

This case study shows the design, engineering, and delivery of a three-bedroom, two-bathroom container home produced by NEW BRAND. Lived as a permanent family residence, the luxury 3-bedroom container residential home project outlines how our modular flat-pack construction delivers the comfort and layout flexibility of a conventional single-story house with less setup time and site disruption.

51-Meter Modular Labor Camp Accommodation Case Study
This case study documents the completion of a 51-meter modular labor camp accommodation project delivered by NEW BRAND, featuring a large-scale, single-story accommodation block designed for remote workforce housing. The structure spans 51,170 mm and integrates 20+ individual sleeping rooms arranged in a double-row configuration with a central corridor—offering efficient and rapidly deployable living quarters for workers in field environments.



The modular labor camp housing was engineered, prefabricated, and installed as a flat-pack container structure with a corrugated steel roof, sandwich panel wall cladding, and durable structural framing. It exemplifies NEW BRAND's ability to deliver turnkey modular labor camp solutions to the oil & gas, construction, mining, and infrastructure sectors worldwide.
